title: Bank Deposit Payouts at the Per-Transfer Ceiling: Limits and Levels Callbacks on the Personal Sender Account
content:
For a callback on limits and levels to a Personal Sender Account holder, payouts at the per-transfer ceiling are the Bank Deposit payouts sent in the 6 months before the callback request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 6 months earlier or before it no longer counting, whose USD principal equals exactly the per-transfer limit of the Personal Sender Account level the account holds on the callback request date.

- When there are 3 or more, 3 business days are taken off the counted limits callback window.
- When there are at least 1 but fewer than 3, 2 business days are taken off the counted limits callback window.
- When there is none, nothing is taken off for payouts at the ceiling.

## The per-transfer limit compared

| Level held on the callback request date | Per-transfer limit a payout must equal exactly (USD) |
|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 999.00 |
| Paloma Verified | 2999.00 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 6000.00 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 15000.00 |
| Paloma Premier | 35000.00 |
| Paloma Private Client | 75000.00 |

The payouts are the payout sent entries in the ledgers of the customer's Bank Deposit transfers, compared by their USD amount. Cash Pickup and Mobile Wallet payouts are not counted.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Level held | Bank Deposit payouts sent in the 6 months (USD) | At the ceiling | Business days taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Verified | 2999.00, 2999.00, 2999.00, 1500.00 | 3 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified | 2999.00, 2998.99 | 1 | 2 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 2999.00, 2999.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 15000.00, 15000.00 | 2 | 2 |

The third case shows that the comparison is with the limit of the level held on the callback request date: payouts of 2999.00 USD are not at the Paloma Verified Plus limit of 6000.00 USD.
